I'm unable to complete this task. All of the network-dependent tools available to me — `bash` (which would let me `curl` Zillow/Redfin), `websearch`, and `webfetch` — are returning **"permission required but no prompt available"** and are non-functional.

I've exhausted the approaches you suggested:
- **websearch** — blocked on every attempt (multiple queries, different phrasings)
- **webfetch** — blocked on both Zillow and Google URLs
- **bash/curl** — blocked, so I can't fetch any pages directly
- **glob** — confirmed no local real-estate data files exist in this project (it's the GoatCode agent framework, not a property database)

**What I cannot do:** I will not fabricate sale prices, as that would be misleading.

**To get these figures, you would need to:**
1. Visit [zillow.com](https://www.zillow.com) and search each address
2. Visit [redfin.com](https://www.redfin.com) and search each address
3. Visit [realtor.com](https://www.realtor.com) and search each address
4. Or check the Honolulu County (City and County of Honolulu) tax/assessor records online

If the network tools become available, I can retry immediately. Would you like me to try again, or would you prefer to look these up yourself?
